verdict.rationale: Sierra's own docs say agents can be published via CI/CD. The Agent SDK lets teams write journeys as code within their development workflows, with Agent Checks/Simulations and merge approval workflows that suggest pipeline-driven automation. However, the only explicit CI/CD mention is for the ChatGPT publishing action, and there is no documented headless CLI or API for running the product in CI. missing for 10: documented headless CLI/API for running tests and deployments, CI configuration docs or examples, evidence that simulations run in CI pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Make your agent available on ChatGPT with the push of a button, or via CI/CD.
write customer journeys as code, track changes, and build sophisticated logic without giving up our development workflows
Agent Checks and Simulations catching problems proactively, merge approval workflows putting a person in the loop
